translations.web: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
translations.bsb: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
translations.kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
translations.asv: And there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads: when they stood, they let down their wings.
